cohort: 702 pregnancies in women with lupus (31 Indigenous Australian, 357 non-Indigenous) in Western Australia
finding: While preterm birth rates and live birth rates were similar, Indigenous Australian women with lupus experienced a higher burden of comorbidities, including renal flares, gestational diabetes, and infections, during pregnancy compared to non-Indigenous women with lupus.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery rates were significantly higher in non-Indigenous women with lupus compared to Indigenous Australian women with lupus (47.2% vs 30%, P = 0.02).
